backfillRows.why: feat-9288 (Impossible Magic pg. 88) prints "You gain the magus's Spellstrike activity" exactly as feat-2948 (Secrets of Magic pg. 75) did, but the reprint page carries no <document id="action-4260"> embed, so the importer's link-derived grantsActions came out empty and the dedication stopped handing the player Spellstrike. The printed rule is unchanged; only the Archives' markup is missing.

feat-9307 (Impossible Magic pg. 91) prints "You gain an eidolon as well as the Manifest Eidolon activity" exactly as feat-2953 (Secrets of Magic pg. 76) did, but the reprint page carries no <document id="action-4267"> embed, so grantsActions came out empty. Same markup gap as spellstriker above.

findings.note: The newest-printing repoint moved both feats onto their Impossible Magic pages; those pages lost the action hyperlink the Secrets of Magic pages carried. Caught by scripts/wg-regate-all.mjs (batches 009 and 012 went red on KINDS/IDENTITY/EXPERIENCE, both naming the missing giveAbilityBlock). Swept the whole 384-record repoint set: these are the only two grantsActions losses.
